Recurring care

Annual property maintenance you never have to chase

Mowing, bed care and seasonal work on a set schedule, billed automatically each month. One crew, one agreement, done.

Request an estimate Call (225) 324-8252
The problem

Chasing a lawn crew every few weeks gets old.

Most homeowners are tired of calling around every time the grass gets tall. A recurring agreement means set service days, a defined scope and automatic billing - the work just happens.

Because we also renovate and install, the same crew that maintains your property is the one that can rebuild it when it is time.

What's included
  • ✓Mowing, edging and blowing on a set schedule
  • ✓Bed weeding and seasonal cleanups
  • ✓Shrub and hedge trimming
  • ✓Mulch and pine straw refreshes
  • ✓Priority scheduling for extra work
  • ✓Automatic monthly billing
Property Maintenance

Every property is different. Your scope depends on size, materials, accessibility, service frequency, and project scope. Free consultations and customized written estimates are always available.

What affects your estimate
  • Property size
  • Service frequency
  • Beds included or turf only
  • Number of visits per month
  • Add-on seasonal work

Questions

Property Maintenance FAQs

How does billing work?
Recurring agreements are billed automatically each month, so there is nothing to remember and no invoice to chase.
Can I include beds and just not mowing?
Yes. We scope the plan to what you want - turf only, beds only, or the whole property.
Do you take over from another company?
Often. Tell us who you use now and what is missing, and we will build a plan that fixes it.
